summary: Canvas node views and authoring adapters. Shared Canvas and Host Generator APIs own persisted semantics.

key_files.PluginViewNode.tsx: Storyboard workspace placement with a non-connectable target handle for shared Asset-reference projections and the existing Open View action.
key_files.ActionBadge.tsx: Model and mapped Action forms. Native authoring commits Generator revisions; input references retain immutable Asset identities.
key_files.NativeOrderedPrompt.tsx: Edits ordered prompt text while preserving revision input identities.
key_files.NativeMediaReference.tsx: Displays an applied media input without requiring a Canvas placement.
key_files.NativeDocumentReference.tsx: Reads the exact plain-text Document input revision and removes it through the parent revision editor.
key_files.TextDocumentNode.tsx: Read-only Canvas placement for plain text and structured analysis Documents. Pending/failed outputs remain visible without inventing a Document; completed placements read the exact revision.
key_files.NativeActionRunNode.tsx: Read-only generic native Run placement: frozen input references, parameters, status and committed outputs; never invokes a model composer or changes historical parameters when the Generator head advances.
key_files.GeneratorReferenceThumbnail.tsx: Shared native reference thumbnail used by Canvas and embedded Generator Composer.
